[SWS_DM_01788] Realization of
SOVD
Write Configuration
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04261
⌈
If the SOVD method
Write Configuration
is called for an explicitly modelled
SOVD Configuration the
Diagnostic Server instance
shall call
ara::diag::
SovdConfiguration::RequestPutConfiguration
.
⌋
